product.olivetti-m380-c-new.summary: The compact service revision moved to VGA and a combined RLL controller.
product.olivetti-m380-c-new.history: Olivetti’s guide distinguishes the M380 C New in the compact line. The Centre for Computing History’s 1988 M380/C has the adapters the guide associates with that revision and was used in the Pandora project.
product.olivetti-m380-c-new.architecture: The controller combined hard disk and floppy. The guide documents GO723 with ST-506 RLL and GO470/GO481 VGA for the C New.
product.olivetti-m380-c-new.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m380-c-new.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m380-c-new.service: Olivetti, Pocket Service Guide, vol. I, §7.
product.olivetti-m380-c-new.museum: Centre for Computing History, Olivetti M380/C (Pandora Project).
